title: Source: https://api.github.com/advisories/GHSA-g4xw-jxrg-5f6m
summary: Server-side rendering of untrusted MDX produced a real, GitHub-reviewed high-severity code-execution vulnerability.
notes: Quoted from the page, verified present at retrieval time: "The serialize function used to compile MDX in next-mdx-remote is vulnerable to arbitrary code execution due to insufficient sanitization of MDX content." ⚠️ The full document was NOT retained — there is no capture store yet (7b builds capture plans). What survives is the locator, the retrieval date and the verified quote.
